FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Outdoor Adventure Emporium, our core operations revolve around providing a diverse range of high-quality camping and outdoor recreational equipment. We specialize in retailing new gear for various activities, including camping, hiking, and outdoor sports. Our knowledgeable staff is trained to offer expert advice and product recommendations, ensuring that customers make informed choices for their adventures. We prioritize customer safety by conducting regular in-store instructional activities that promote the safe and responsible use of equipment. Our inventory management system is robust, with documented vendor relationships to guarantee the authenticity and compliance of our products. We operate under strict adherence to safety standards and consumer protection laws, ensuring a secure shopping experience for our clientele. Our facilities are equipped with enhanced security measures, such as monitored burglar alarms, to mitigate the risk of theft or burglary. Overall, we are committed to fostering a vibrant outdoor community while ensuring a high level of service and product safety.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 08/15/2023, a break-in occurred at our store resulting in the theft of outdoor gear and merchandise valued at $1,200. The incident was reported to law enforcement, and we have since enhanced our security measures to mitigate future risks. The status of this loss is ongoing as we work through the claims process with our insurance provider.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM, Sunday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed Safe.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security fencing and on-site watchpersons during operational hours.
